release.label: Public research preview
release.detail: iPhone smoke + Duo and iPad native trials · full acceptance pending
release.publicStatus: Source is public as a research preview. The iPhone 16 profile scenario and CounterLab smoke passed. One closed-Duo session rendered local fixture video and recovered playback after a long pause. A controlled cold boot reached BruTV Home. An iPad mini guest completed migration, launched CounterLab built with SDK 27.2, displayed the expected UIKit metrics and responded to QMP virtual touchscreen input. A separate experimental worker trial in diagnostic graphics returned matching display bounds, and a read-only scale check confirmed no change was needed. Automated iPad inspection remains blocked by unknown FrontBoard orientation. Clean creation, repeatable cold startup, general app performance and complete profile acceptance remain pending.

guest.label: iPhone 16 compatible run
guest.detail: A fresh iPhone 16 guest running iOS 27.0.1, build 24A446, completed ordinary Setup Assistant through the UI without setup or migration marker edits. The controlled 12-step profile scenario passed OS, UIKit idiom, point-size, and scale checks. A separate compatible-graphics CounterLab smoke passed all 26 steps, including reset and increment, semantic scrolling and taps, Details navigation, Unicode text input, Home, and count 1 after app terminate/relaunch. The note is transient. DataMigrator success: false leaves clean creation unaccepted.

sample.label: CounterLab · SDK 27.2
sample.detail: CounterLab's warm Release build took 3.03 seconds with the Xcode 27.2 SDK. This proves the build step only and does not measure app performance.

runtime.label: Native runtime proof
runtime.workflowValue: iPhone smoke + Duo and iPad trials
runtime.detail: CounterLab smoke passed on one iPhone 16 guest. A closed-Duo session rendered local H.264 HLS video and recovered after a long pause; one controlled cold boot reached BruTV Home. On iPad mini, an SDK 27.2 app visibly reported iPadOS 27.0.1, the iPad idiom, 744 × 1133 points and 2× scale. A separate experimental worker trial in diagnostic graphics returned matching FrontBoard bounds, and one QMP virtual USB touchscreen tap changed the count from 1 to 2. A guarded read-only scale check returned unchanged 2× scale without restart. These results show guest UI and input, not GPU fidelity or performance. Automated iPad inspection still refuses unknown FrontBoard orientation. The iPhone migration failure, repeatable cold startup and complete profile acceptance remain open.
runtime.faq: Native checks include iPhone CounterLab smoke, one closed-Duo video recovery trial, BruTV Home after one cold boot, and iPad CounterLab metrics and QMP touchscreen input. The iPad trial used diagnostic graphics and does not establish GPU fidelity or performance. A guarded read-only scale check returned unchanged 2× scale without restart. Automated inspection still refuses unknown FrontBoard orientation. These trials do not establish complete device acceptance or repeatable cold startup.

workflowNote: CounterLab builds with SDK 27.2. Native checks cover iPhone smoke, selected Duo playback and cold-start behavior, and an iPad app displaying the expected UIKit metrics and responding to a QMP touchscreen tap. A separate experimental worker trial in diagnostic graphics returned matching display metrics; a guarded read-only scale check made no change and required no restart. Automated iPad inspection remains blocked by its FrontBoard orientation report. Complete creation, repeatable cold startup and full profile acceptance remain pending.

faq.release: The public preview has native iPhone, Duo and iPad evidence. The iPad completed migration and ran CounterLab with the expected UIKit metrics. One experimental worker trial in diagnostic graphics returned matching display metrics, and a guarded read-only scale check made no change. Automated UI inspection is still blocked. The iPhone migration failure, repeatable cold startup, app performance and complete device acceptance remain open.
